solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Part of body nearly robed after losing clothing

indicators.note: the clothing of each word is its outer letters, so both nearly and robed are stripped of their first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone half-dressed after shedding their clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' only joins the definition to the wordplay; it is not a charade order signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The fleshy lower lobe of the ear is a small part of the human body.

clue.text: Years of retrial forgotten, off and on

indicators.note: letters of retrial are alternately forgotten and kept, the second, fourth and sixth surviving

explanation.surface: A court case abandoned and resumed over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period of time, a span of years.

clue.text: Noah saw this ark shortly erected in front of boat

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising something upright reads it from the bottom upwards
cut short, the word ark loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming
taken as written
the bow is the forward end of a vessel

explanation.surface: Biblical scene: Noah watches the ark being built ahead of a smaller vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: AR (ark shortened) is turned upwards by 'erected' to give RA.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis a rainbow appeared to Noah after the flood as the sign of God's covenant.

clue.text: Perhaps Heart of Racing given another name to begin with

indicators.note: the opening letter of each of these five words is taken

explanation.surface: A racehorse called Heart of Racing has been renamed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks Heart as an example; the capital H disguises it as part of a horse's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The heart is one example of a bodily organ, alongside the liver or lungs.

parts.note: to egg someone on is to urge them
to head a group is to lead it

explanation.surface: A clever person feels the urge to take charge.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An egghead is a colloquial term for a highbrow, intellectual person.

clue.text: Pipe only going west and east

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading right to left, backwards

parts.note: but means only, as in 'but a child'
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A pipe that runs just west and east.
explanation.definitionFit: A tube is a hollow cylinder, a synonym for a pipe.

indicators.note: something sabotaged is wrecked, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the company name AT&T with its possessive s gives the letters A, T, T, S

explanation.surface: A US telecoms firm undermines a European's verdict.
explanation.walkthrough: The ampersand is ignored, leaving ATTS to mix with E.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste means discernment or aesthetic judgment, as in 'a person of taste'.

clue.text: … and BT lied about when connection could be made

indicators.note: about signals that the letters are moved around into a new arrangement

parts.note: the letters BT taken as written

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, BT, the British phone company, is accused of lying about when a line could be connected.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipses tie this to the previous clue's telecoms story; BT is British Telecom. Here the 'connection' is romantic, not a phone line.
explanation.definitionFit: A blind date is an arranged meeting between strangers, where a romantic connection might be made.

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means about
a ring is the traditional present at an engagement

explanation.surface: A considerate person wonders about an engagement present.
explanation.definitionFit: Caring and thoughtful both describe someone considerate towards others.

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
to soil something is to dirty it

explanation.surface: Georgia pollutes its fuel supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Gas oil is a type of diesel fuel distilled from petroleum.

clue.text: Blade Gunner originally? It's a myth

indicators.note: asking what the phrase was originally invites rearranging its letters back to a first form

explanation.surface: A film title, Blade Gunner, rumoured to be the real original name of Blade Runner.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the film Blade Runner, inviting a story about its supposed original title.
explanation.definitionFit: An urban legend is a widely circulated but untrue story, a modern myth.

clue.text: US city's vicar in uniform raised Catholic

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the whole string is read from bottom to top

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, plus the possessive s
Rev, short for Reverend, is a vicar's title
taken as written
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A Los Angeles priest in uniform was brought up a Catholic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns LASREVINU upwards. 'Catholic' is used in its lower-case sense, not the church.
explanation.definitionFit: Catholic in its older sense means all-embracing or universal, as in catholic tastes.

indicators.note: the little word in is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: taken as written before turning
a twit is a silly person

explanation.surface: One fool turns on another.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitwit is a stupid person, a synonym for a fool.

definitions.meaning: a short promotional preview advertising a film
a towed vehicle, needing something to pull it

explanation.walkthrough: 'tower' is read as tow-er, something that tows, not a tall building.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer is both a film preview and a wheeled vehicle hauled behind a car.

indicators.note: treated suggests the letters are processed into a new form
without tells us to leave the named letters out of the word maladies

parts.note: the letters A and E, as in the hospital Accident and Emergency department

explanation.surface: Illnesses dealt with without the emergency department sounds dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' tells you to remove A and E from MALADIES, then rearrange the rest. A&E is a British hospital's Accident and Emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal can mean dreadful or of poor quality, as in a dismal performance.

clue.text: War poet before long supports soldiers

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that supports another sits below it

parts.note: the SAS is the British Special Air Service regiment
soon means before long

explanation.surface: A war poet will soon be backing the troops.
explanation.walkthrough: Siegfried Sassoon was a First World War poet. SOON goes under SAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Siegfried Sassoon was an English poet famed for verse about the First World War trenches.

indicators.note: struggling suggests turmoil, so these letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: The Irish leader struggles to keep smiling.
explanation.definitionFit: The Emerald Isle is a poetic nickname for Ireland, from its green landscape.

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the word for career runs backwards

parts.note: to career is to rush or race

explanation.surface: An online note reminds someone of a careers day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' is the verb meaning to rush, not a job.
explanation.definitionFit: An e-card is a greeting card sent electronically by email.

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the middle of the other

parts.note: a dam is a barrier holding back water
RE means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Imagining an escape that bursts through a barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A dream is an imagined scene or wish, a synonym for fantasy.

indicators.note: the run of letters is read backwards
only part of the words is used, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A country whose murky situation has been partly turned around.
explanation.walkthrough: Reading 'unclear situation' backwards gives noitautis raelcnu, with the answer across 'tis rael'. The 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: Adequate individual getting rejected? That's horrible!

indicators.note: something rejected is turned back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: one means a single individual
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: Someone is turned down as merely adequate and finds it horrible.
explanation.definitionFit: Enough as an adjective means sufficient or adequate.

clue.text: Something said to horse missing the fence, ultimately

indicators.note: the final letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: A rider calls out to a horse that has refused the fence.
explanation.definitionFit: Gee or gee-up is a command urging a horse forward.

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an LED is a light-emitting diode

explanation.surface: A dark lamp leaked fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: To bleed is to let out blood or sap, so bled means let liquid seep out.

parts.note: Roman, as in Roman Catholic
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Affection for the Catholic Church.
explanation.definitionFit: Romance is a feeling of love and excitement in a relationship.
